Twilight Session Episode 252 07/11/2026



Soulful and Sexy!

Playing the best in Neo under played soul and independent soul. Featured artists include Val B King, HMLT, Jorgia Smith, Dawn, Alex Isley, Carpinteria plus many many more.



Catch me every Saturday between 9pm-11pm for great beats with great vibes on dejavufm.com.
